meta_description: Paul Bevins Decorating brings expert interior and exterior painting to Leicester homes. Professional finish, competitive rates, free quotes. Call today.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting that transforms your home. From feature walls to full house redecoration, we deliver lasting results with a professional finish.
services_subhead: From interior repaints and feature walls to full exterior redecoration, Paul Bevins handles every job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Complete interior repaints, feature walls, and bespoke colour schemes. We prep surfaces properly and use premium finishes that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Woodwork
services.desc: Exterior wall repaints, fascia, soffits, and door frames. We protect your home's weatherproofing whilst enhancing kerb appeal.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging and removal. Perfect for feature walls or complete room makeovers with patterns that matter.

services.title: Woodwork & Carpentry Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, architraves, doors, and built-in cabinetry finished to specification. Precision painting and staining for a premium look.

services.title: Landlord & Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Fast turnaround residential lets and commercial spaces. Reliable scheduling, minimal disruption, move-in ready results.

services.title: Preparation & Restoration
services.desc: Surface preparation including sanding, filling, and repair. We restore tired surfaces to pristine condition before the final coat.

about_pullquote: I take pride in work that lasts and customers who recommend me to friends.
about_para_1: Paul Bevins Decorating has been transforming Leicester homes and commercial spaces for over 18 years. What started as a single tradesman has grown into a trusted local business, built on solid preparation, quality materials, and meticulous attention to detail. Every job, whether a small bedroom refresh or a full house exterior, receives the same professional care.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on reliability and honest pricing. We turn up on time, work tidily, and leave your space spotless. Customers come back to us because we listen to what you want, deliver what we promise, and always leave you with a finish you're proud of.

reviews.text: Paul painted our whole house inside and out. Brilliant job, very tidy worker and the finish is immaculate. Best decision was giving him a call. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had Paul in to do two bedrooms and the hallway. Dead easy to work with, turned up when he said he would, and the colour scheme he suggested looks amazing. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Emma K.

reviews.text: Needed a quick redecorate before letting the flat. Paul fitted us in at short notice, worked efficiently, and the tenants loved it. Will definitely use him again.
reviews.author: David M.
